title: True Positive
body:
Predicted positive, actually positive. A correct catch, and the top-left cell of the
[[Confusion Matrix]].

It is the numerator of both rates that matter: [[Sensitivity]] is $\text{TP}/(\text{TP}+\text{FN})$
(of the real positives, how many did you find) and precision is
$\text{TP}/(\text{TP}+\text{FP})$ (of your positive calls, how many were right). Same numerator,
different denominator, and confusing the two is the standard mistake.

In [[STATISTICS]] this is correctly rejecting a false $H_0$, so its rate is statistical power
$1-\beta$. See [[Type I and Type II Errors]] for the full translation.
